entries.introEn: Trinity makes color and movement inseparable. Three rings share one space, so the composition changes as their positions shift; each gold tone appears, disappears and returns. That quality makes the ring interesting beyond its familiar silhouette. Look at it from above, then from the side, and notice how the gaps contribute as much as the metal.
